title: DISE Readiness Gap Analyzer
description: Reads a DISE caption-to-category coverage matrix (the T581 matrix builder's output, or a caller-pasted equivalent) and classifies every required-category by income-statement-caption cell as no_coverage, partial_coverage or full_coverage. Ranks the gaps by materiality when dollar amounts are supplied, otherwise by declared category order, and returns a plain-English remediation note for each gap. Verify-only: it measures coverage of the pasted mapping and never asserts that a disclosure requirement has been met.

required_categories.description: Natural-expense categories the entity has determined it must report separately. Caller-declared: no fixed FASB enum is enforced.

amount.description: Optional annual amount used to rank gaps by materiality

captions.description: Income statement captions in scope, each optionally carrying a total balance

coverage_rows.description: Caption plus category coverage rows, matching the matrix builder's output shape

rows.description: Mapped trial balance row count for that caption and category

threshold_pct.description: Dollar coverage percentage at or above which a caption counts as fully mapped. Default 95.

cells.description: Every required-category by caption cell with its classification

gaps.description: Cells that are not full_coverage, ranked, each carrying a remediation note

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_dise_readiness_gaps
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classifies every required-DISE-category by income-statement-caption cell as no_coverage, partial_coverage or full_coverage from a pasted coverage matrix, ranks the gaps by materiality or category, and returns a plain-English remediation note for each. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

coverage_rows.description: Caption plus category coverage rows from the matrix builder
